notes.title: Alpha 5 Update is Here!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the release of Alpha 5 for Triton Survival! This update brings a ton of new features, improvements, and optimizations to enhance your gameplay experience. Here’s what’s new:

New Features & Additions


 Sentinel System: A brand-new bot with scanning, mining, and attack capabilities.
 Sentinel Function Controls: Enable or disable specific Sentinel functions through its menu.
 New Items: A variety of new items have been added to enrich your survival journey.
 Vehicle Crafting Components: New parts introduced for vehicle construction.
 Vehicle Crafting: Players can now craft vehicles to navigate the hostile environment more efficiently.
 Improved Vehicle Reception Base: Enhancements to the base where vehicles arrive.
 New Enemies: Additional enemy types added to challenge your survival skills.
 Enemy Nests: New enemy nests scattered throughout the world for increased encounters.


Planetary & Gameplay Enhancements


 Planet Triton & Planet Larisa Improvements: Certain environments have been modified to improve the overall planetary experience.
 Wave System Enhancements: Improved mechanics for enemy waves.
 Storage Container Inventory Improvements: Optimized inventory management for storage containers.
 Improved Object Persistence Across Planets: Objects placed on different planets will now save and load more reliably.


This update marks another step in refining and expanding Triton Survival, and we can’t wait for you to try it out! As always, we appreciate your feedback, so let us know what you think and report any issues you encounter.

Family Devs.

notes.title: Update 4.1 & New Team Members
notes.notes:
Hi community,

A new Triton Survival Update is available!

In this Update 4.1 we've added new content:

- A new enemy, the alien spider

- Beacons to mark points of interest on the Triton map

- A shield to protect the intergalactic portal

- New items for crafting vehicles

- New environments

- More enemies in some areas

Some bugs have also been fixed:

- Item loss with inventory of containers 

- Item loss with inventory of extractor resources

- Item loss from the hot bar

- Improved character physics

Thanks to all players who send us feedback via Steam forums or email. We really appreciate your comments and suggestions.

We're still working hard on the development of Triton Survival.

I'm happy to share with you some news: since a few months we're 3 members in the team. 

For a long time I have been a solo developer but... My 2 sons finished their higher studies and joined the DreamsSoftGames team. We're very happy and motivated!

We'll be announcing fresh news soon...

Best wishes.
DreamsSoftGames Team.

notes.title: Working on a new update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34321103/8348cdeae0f32dd1f07ed45095660357ad22b434.png

Hi community,

One of the features of the next update will be a new enemy that will be present in some locations of Triton and will bring more excitement to the exploration. Also, the number of enemies on screen has been increased.

Some areas of the map have been modified and others have been expanded. There will also be some new items, such as the beacon, which is designed to locate some points on the map that are interesting for their location or for the resources that can be obtained there.

It will also fix some of the bugs that the player community has been reporting over the last few months. In this way the game will be more polished and with less bugs.

The update will be available soon. Thank you for your patience.

Best wishes.

DreamsSoftGames

notes.title: Updated Alpha version 1.07
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34321103/ea914454187e29c42687b03a1cc225021ce45406.jpg

Hi, we updated to Alpha 1.07:
- Added a new feature: invert mouse Y axis (in main menu and ingame menu). In addition this data will be saved when you leave the game.
- Fixed minor bugs.

We know it is a very small update. But we have good reasons for this. We are designing the first planet you can travel to: Larisa (you can see a little screenshot in this news).

We are working on designing his mapping, some interesting areas, an alien base with a portal, some new resources and other interesting sites. We are also implementing the first vehicle, since Larisa is a planet with dimensions larger than the current map of Triton.

We still need a little more time to implement all this. Please, a little more patience. In the next update we hope to upload an experimental version to make the first trips through the Triton portal.

We continue working hard! Best regards!

notes.title: Updated Alpha version 1.06
notes.notes:
Hi, we updated to Alpha 1.06:

- Optimized transition time from the inventory menu to the game.
- Now you can press escape key to close menus (inventory, extractor, oxygenator, ...)
- Now you obtain experience points when extracting resources with the extractor blaster.
- Creation of nails multiplied x10.
- Running mode time multiplied by x2.
- Added audio menu ingame.
- Production of Nitrous Oxide fuel for the multiplied jetpack x10.
- Reduction of fuel consumption by half on resource extractors.
- Possibility of moving or saving the inventory of extractors, containers, oxygenators, generators and other elements without losing their fuel, their inventory and other data.
- Fixed a bug that caused objects to be duplicated when moving them and reloading the game.
- Fixed bug to finish jetpack sound when landing.
- Fixed bug indicating an erroneous number of craftable maximum objects.
- Fixed bug in interactive text on screen that was displayed above other menus.

Best regards!

notes.title: Updated Alpha version 1.05
notes.notes:
Hi, we updated to Alpha 1.05:

- Main menu configured for screen resolution of 3840 x 2160.
- Splitted into 2 keys: use jetpack (space key) and run (R key).
- Changed the jetpack mechanics to allow multiple pulsations and to plan in the air.
- Reduced fuel consumption in the jetpack and multiplied by 10 the production of fuel (nitrous oxide).
- Reduced the speed of heating of the jetpack.
- Possibility of moving the oxygenator without losing fuel.
- Fixed bug in interactive text on screen that was displayed above other menus.
- Fixed bug with some saved games.
- Fixed bug with some player skills that had incorrect values.
- Fixed bug in the scoreboard that indicates the necessary points to go up to the next level when starting the game.

We still have some more bugs that we are working on. We hope to solve them as soon as possible.

Best regards!

notes.title: Updated Alpha version 1.01
notes.notes:
Hi, yesterday we updated to Alpha version 1.01 fixing some minor bugs:

- Fixed an issue with items cooldown.
- Modified main menu settings to better adapt to different resolutions.
- Improvements in graphics settings menu.
- Improvements in size and visibility of starfishs.

These first days since the launch we are focusing on solving some incidents that the community has asked us to do.

We continue working hard!.
